modelingNotes: Manufacturer accessory table p.14 identifies a protective cap for the 3-pole 16 A plug, excluding extra-low-voltage versions.
Mechanical accessory with zero electrical terminals or circuit functions. The cap covers the plug; it does not electrically terminate, bond or short its pins.
